title: Gravity Gun
description: This datapack adds a working gravity gun to your world that you can use!
body:
Do you wish you could have an easier time moving mobs around? Introducing the gravity gun! This datapack adds a custom gravity gun to your minecraft world which you can use to pick up and move mobs effortlessly.

Command to give yourself the gravity gun:
```
/function grav:give
```

![The Gravity Gun item when on the ground](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7f5ce119425d2ee93acb05a7eb4c8b020523c548_0.webp)
